points.point: Is it true Blotato can't take Drive files over 100 MB?
points.sentence: Blotato does not impose a 100 MB Google Drive cutoff.

points.point: 350 MB video keeps hitting Google's virus scan warning page instead of the file
points.sentence: Google Drive sometimes returns a warning page instead of the file for large videos.

points.point: What to do about the warning page
points.sentence: First, share the file as "Anyone with the link" and use https://drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id=FILE_ID&export=download&confirm=t.

verdict.reason: This entry directly states there is no 100 MB Google Drive cutoff and explains the large-video warning page with a fix, and the Creator plan does not change that answer.
